name: vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3_1015-ft1-COMMIT
owner: Claude:H-ELEM-A (VM bank, from stopped Codex H-VM)
purpose: Static VM bank (RG7/WG3, NW/NE) for the 833.333 ps a1 engine clock: wdecode+CE successor plus (1) sticky fault as a registered 2-level tree (gate reg->reg -71 ps ended at flt), (2) local reset relay (async assert, 3-edge sync release; port drives 3 flops only; gate in->reg -54.2 ps rq_v reset recovery). Same 3 actual SRAMs, slots, read n+6 / commit n+3 / egress n+1, pin ABI. Status fault visibility +2 edges; reset release is initialization mode (+3 edges before the first compiler slot).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; hfd_vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/physical/hfd_vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/vm/static/ot_vms_bank_static_wdecode_ft.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3_1015/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3_1015/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3_1015 --out {RUN}/record/views/hfd_vms_bank_ft_rg7wg3 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
